title: Remode - Visual Fashion Shopping
description: Visual fashion search across retailers and resale, with localized prices and app handoffs.
summary: Visual fashion search across retailers and resale, with localized prices and app handoffs.
offersHint: Visual fashion search across retailers and resale, with localized prices and app handoffs. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://remode-assistant-mcp.onrender.com/mcp?platform=mcp_registry

toolsPreview.name: find_fashion_items
toolsPreview.description: Find where to buy fashion seen in a user-provided photo, screenshot, direct image URL, social post, blog, or product page. Use when the user asks to identify clothing, shoes, bags, jewelry, or accessories; shop an outfit; compare retailers; or find cheaper or second-hand matches. Returns current region-aware retailer and resale listings with product images, verified prices when available, and direct buy links.

toolsPreview.name: watch_item
toolsPreview.description: Persistently add a specific fashion product URL to the connected user's Remode watch list for lower-price or second-hand monitoring. When the supplied product is explicitly marked in_stock=false, the same watch also detects a restock; never infer stock state. Use when the user explicitly asks to watch or track a fashion item or product link. This stores product-watch state inside Remode; it is not a ChatGPT Scheduled task, calendar reminder, or one-time notification, so do not schedule it.

toolsPreview.name: get_watch_updates
toolsPreview.description: Read the linked user's active Remode watches and verified recent updates. Use when the user asks what Remode is watching or whether anything changed.

toolsPreview.name: update_watch
toolsPreview.description: Change whether an existing Remode watch looks for lower prices, second-hand matches, or both. Requires the stable watch_id returned by Remode.

toolsPreview.name: stop_watching_item
toolsPreview.description: Stop an existing Remode watch. Use only after the user asks to stop tracking an item. Requires the stable watch_id returned by Remode.
